# Threadly

> Threadly finds relevant conversations on Reddit matching your keywords, has Claude judge
> whether each one is a genuine lead and how strong their buying intent is (not just a
> keyword match), drafts a reply grounded in the original post, and requires a human to
> approve every single one before anything is ever posted. Nothing is published
> automatically, on any plan.

Threadly is built for founders, indie hackers, and small teams looking for their next
customer without a dedicated growth team. It runs in the background — no login or connected
account is required to find leads — and surfaces what it finds in an Approval Inbox for the
user to review.

Pricing: tiered by signup order (first 5 customers pay $9/month, next 10 pay $19/month,
everyone after that pays $29/month, locked in for as long as the subscription stays active).
A 7-day free trial is available with no card required.
